variables.name: VESICLE_PROVIDERS_FILE
variables.behavior: Override provider registry path; its directory also anchors sibling user state.

variables.name: VESICLE_CONFIG_DIR
variables.behavior: Override user configuration directory when explicit providers path is absent.

variables.name: VESICLE_MCP_FILE
variables.behavior: Override only this domain configuration file.

variables.name: VESICLE_PERMISSIONS_FILE
variables.behavior: Override only this domain configuration file.

variables.name: VESICLE_QUALITY_FILE
variables.behavior: Override only this domain configuration file.

variables.name: VESICLE_HOST_CONFIG_DIR
variables.behavior: Host-injected resolved directory for filtered Skill children; below explicit provider/config overrides.

variables.name: VESICLE_SELF_EXECUTABLE
variables.behavior: Allow first-party Skill wrappers to invoke the exact running runtime; standalone omits entrypoint.

variables.name: VESICLE_SELF_ENTRYPOINT
variables.behavior: Allow first-party Skill wrappers to invoke the exact running runtime; standalone omits entrypoint.

variables.name: VESICLE_HOST_ASSETS_DIR
variables.behavior: Override package-owned host-assets directory after an explicit resolver option and before bundled host resolution; no activation trust bypass is implied.

variables.name: VESICLE_PROVIDER_PROXY
variables.behavior: Explicit provider HTTP/WS proxy; user-file before process; validated/redacted and not bypassed by NO_PROXY.

variables.name: http_proxy
variables.behavior: Inherited target-scheme policy; lowercase proxy before uppercase, NO_PROXY before no_proxy. ALL_PROXY not supported.

variables.name: https_proxy
variables.behavior: Inherited target-scheme policy; lowercase proxy before uppercase, NO_PROXY before no_proxy. ALL_PROXY not supported.

variables.name: HTTP_PROXY
variables.behavior: Inherited target-scheme policy; lowercase proxy before uppercase, NO_PROXY before no_proxy. ALL_PROXY not supported.

variables.name: HTTPS_PROXY
variables.behavior: Inherited target-scheme policy; lowercase proxy before uppercase, NO_PROXY before no_proxy. ALL_PROXY not supported.

variables.name: NO_PROXY
variables.behavior: Inherited target-scheme policy; lowercase proxy before uppercase, NO_PROXY before no_proxy. ALL_PROXY not supported.
variables.default: no extra bypass list; inherited proxy selection still applies

variables.name: no_proxy
variables.behavior: Inherited target-scheme policy; lowercase proxy before uppercase, NO_PROXY before no_proxy. ALL_PROXY not supported.
variables.default: no extra bypass list; inherited proxy selection still applies

variables.name: VESICLE_EDITOR
variables.behavior: Resolve external editor in order VESICLE_EDITOR > settings.editor > VISUAL > EDITOR > platform fallback; split argv without shell.
variables.default: vi on POSIX; notepad on Windows

variables.name: VISUAL
variables.behavior: Resolve external editor in order VESICLE_EDITOR > settings.editor > VISUAL > EDITOR > platform fallback; split argv without shell.
variables.default: vi on POSIX; notepad on Windows

variables.name: EDITOR
variables.behavior: Resolve external editor in order VESICLE_EDITOR > settings.editor > VISUAL > EDITOR > platform fallback; split argv without shell.
variables.default: vi on POSIX; notepad on Windows

variables.name: VESICLE_THEME
variables.behavior: dark/light/default/auto theme preference; invalid value reports a diagnostic; session, launch and project values take precedence.

variables.name: VESICLE_REDUCED_MOTION
variables.behavior: Value 1 freezes splash and title working pulse.

variables.name: VESICLE_TERMINAL_TITLE
variables.behavior: auto/on/off terminal-title projection; invalid values fail closed.

variables.name: VESICLE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE
variables.behavior: Value 1 is a hard no-write boundary including shutdown.

variables.name: VESICLE_DISABLE_FILE_CHECKPOINTING
variables.behavior: Value 1 disables file checkpoint capture; missing fork anchor degrades candidate restore honestly.

variables.name: VESICLE_MARKDOWN_RENDERER
variables.behavior: markdown or plain; text aliases plain; unknown values fall back to markdown.

variables.name: VESICLE_DEBUG_LOG
variables.behavior: 1/true/yes enable local TUI diagnostics under .vesicle/logs/tui-debug.log; logs can contain local paths.

variables.name: OTUI_TREE_SITTER_WORKER_PATH
variables.behavior: TS runtime worker-path override; replacement runtime must retain meaningful debug/diagnostic behavior, not Bun worker implementation.

variables.name: OPENTUI_LIBC
variables.behavior: TS native dependency loader selects musl only for musl; retained platform coverage is in platforms.json.

variables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
variables.behavior: Authenticate supported Skill repository access; never persist token in provenance.

variables.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
variables.behavior: Authenticate Tavily tools using sibling user .env before process fallback; absent credentials hide host web tools from the effective model surface and explicit calls fail as unconfigured.

boundaries: Provider apiKeyEnv names and MCP header placeholders are open-ended configured secret names, not fixed catalogue variables.
OS PATH/home/COMSPEC/terminal/WSL variables support platform discovery; they do not widen model tool authority.
Host-injected variables are process interfaces; runtime-specific TS mechanics are not a requirement to retain Bun in the Rust product.
